content: .{@-ईशः@} ({@वागीशः@}) .²1 an orator, an eloquent man. .²2 an epithet of Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of the gods; वागीशाद्याः सुमनसः <ls>Nyāyamālā.</ls> .²3 an epithet of Brahman; वागीशं (धातारं) वाग्भिरर्थ्याभिः प्रणिपत्योपतस्थिरे <ls>Ku. 2. 3</ls>. .²4 the lunar mansion called Puṣya. . ({@-शा@}) <ab>N.</ab> of Sarasvatī.
